description: This file defines enums, structs, and function prototypes related to conditions in the lighttpd web server configuration, including comparison operators, request fields, condition values, and condition checking functions.

classes.name: liConditionLValue
classes.description: Represents a request or response field or environment variable used in conditions.

classes.name: liConditionRValue
classes.description: Represents the right-hand value in a condition, which can be a boolean, number, string, regex, or IP address.

classes.name: liCondition
classes.description: Encapsulates a condition with an operator, left value, and right value.

classes.name: liConditionValue
classes.description: Holds the value used in condition evaluation, with type and data union.

methods.name: li_condition_lvalue_new
methods.description: Creates a new condition left value of specified type and key.

methods.name: li_condition_lvalue_acquire
methods.description: Increments reference count for a condition left value.

methods.name: li_condition_lvalue_release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and releases a condition left value.

methods.name: li_condition_acquire
methods.description: Increments reference count for a condition.

methods.name: li_condition_release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and releases a condition.

methods.name: li_comp_op_to_string
methods.description: Converts comparison operator enum to string.

methods.name: li_cond_lvalue_to_string
methods.description: Converts a condition lvalue enum to string.

methods.name: li_cond_lvalue_from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the corresponding lvalue enum.

methods.name: li_condition_check
methods.description: Checks if a condition matches the current request, returning result.

methods.name: li_condition_get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a condition's lvalue for the current request.

methods.name: li_condition_value_to_string
methods.description: Converts a condition value to string for debugging or matching.
